title: Microsoft.Entra/entitlementManagement/catalogs
description: An entitlement management catalog (accessPackageCatalog). The resource name is the displayName, unique in the tenant.

displayName.description: Set from the resource name; declaring it is only allowed when it equals the name.

isExternallyVisible.description: Whether users of connected organizations can request packages of the catalog. Defaults to false on create.

permissions.notes: Learn (entitlementmanagement-post-catalogs, accesspackagecatalog-update, accesspackagecatalog-delete): EntitlementManagement.ReadWrite.All is the least privileged permission for writes, EntitlementManagement.Read.All for reads. Least privileged roles: catalog creator (create), catalog owner (update, delete), or Identity Governance Administrator. The tenant needs Microsoft Entra ID P2 or ID Governance.
